text: This report recommends that the name "Porch View Dances Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located east of Manning Avenue, extending southerly from London Street to William Oliphant Lane. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Porch View Dances Lane" for an existing public lane located east of Manning Avenue, extending southerly from London Street to William Oliphant Lane.
